viator_experiences.title: Leeds Heritage Beer Guided Tour
viator_experiences.summary: Get to know Leeds' historic beer industry on a small-group tour, limited to ten people, of some of the city's best-loved pubs. The tour begins at The…
viator_experiences.description_md: Get to know Leeds' historic beer industry on a small-group tour, limited to ten people, of some of the city's best-loved pubs. The tour begins at The Tetley arts hub, set in the iconic former Tetley brewery, and takes in the former flagship Adelphi, The Duck & Drake on Leeds' oldest street, the White Swan and the 300-year-old Whitelock's Ale House. Five half pints of locally brewed beer from highly rated breweries are included, alongside in-depth local knowledge from an experienced beer-industry guide. Along the way you'll hear about local history and walk some of the city's oldest streets. The experience lasts approximately three and a half hours and is suitable for adults aged 18 and over.

viator_experiences.description_md: Make the most of your time in Leeds by joining a Leeds Breweries Bus Tour, which takes in three local breweries in a single day. A driver handles all transport between the sites in an air-conditioned minivan, so there is no need to plan any logistics. At each stop you meet the brewers, hear about their techniques and enjoy included beer tastings. It is a hassle-free, time-saving way for beer fans to sample the city's craft breweries.

viator_experiences.description_md: Explore Harrogate on a half-day lunchtime walking food tour, strolling past the town's key sights while stopping at five different eateries and venues. Along the way you sample a range of local treats and produce, much of it from independent establishments that support local suppliers. A friendly, knowledgeable guide shares stories about Harrogate's history and character between stops. Over roughly three hours the tastings add up to the equivalent of a hearty meal.

viator_experiences.description_md: Step aboard the Dalesman canal boat for a Yorkshire Dales canal cruise with a difference. Guests choose their favourite drink and let the host pour it, whether that be gin, a cocktail, whisky, wine, craft beer or cider. Just like a pub but afloat, this narrowboat follows a scenic route along the Leeds-Liverpool Canal while you learn a little about the canals and the boats. The two-hour experience includes five drink tokens and offers an immersive, quintessentially Yorkshire day out. It is strictly for adults and makes an ideal choice for a party or get-together.
